dt2.7:1.5: Manāyatanena ye dhammā sampayuttā, tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā te dhammā katīhi khandhehi katīhi āyatanehi katīhi dhātūhi vippayuttā?
dt2.7:1.6: Te dhammā catuhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena sattahi dhātūhi vippayuttā
dt2.7:1.7: ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā kehici vippayuttā. Dhātuk_VII.2
dt2.7:2.3: Manoviññāṇadhātuyā ye dhammā sampayuttā, tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā
dt2.7:2.4: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Na kehici khandhehi na kehici āyatanehi ekāya dhātuyā vippāyuttā. Dhātuk_VII.3
dt2.7:3.1: Manindriyena ye dhammā sampayuttā tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā
dt2.7:3.2: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Catuhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena sattahi dhātūhi vippayuttā
dt2.7:4.1: Dhātuk_VII.4 Upekhindriyena ye dhammā sampayuttā tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā
dt2.7:4.2: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Na kehici khandhehi na kehici āyatanehi pañcahi dhātūhi vippayuttā.
dt2.7:5.9: Manasikārena ye dhammā sampayuttā tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā
dt2.7:5.10: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Catuhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena sattahi dhātūhi vippayuttā
dt2.7:5.11: ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā kehici vippayuttā. Dhātuk_VII.6
dt2.7:6.1: Adhimokkhena ye dhammā sampayuttā tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā
dt2.7:6.2: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Na kehici khandhehi na kehici āyatanehi ekāya dhātuyā vippayuttā. Dhātuk_VII.7
dt2.7:7.1: Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttehi dhammehi ye dhammā --
dt2.7:7.2: Upekhā-sahagatehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā
dt2.7:7.3: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Na kehici khandhehi na kehici āyatanehi pañcahi dhātūhi vippayuttā.
dt2.7:8.1: Dhātuk_VII.8 Savitakka-savicārehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā
dt2.7:8.2: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Na kehici khandhehi na kehici āyatanehi ekāya dhātuyā vippayuttā. Dhātuk_VII.9
dt2.7:9.7: Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattīhi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā
dt2.7:9.8: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Catuhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena sattahi dhātūhi vippayuttā
dt2.7:9.9: ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā kehici vippayuttā. Dhātuk_VII.10
dt2.7:10.2: Savicārehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā
dt2.7:10.3: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Na kehici khandhehi na kehici āyatanehi ekāya dhātuyā vippayuttā.
dt2.7:11.1: Dhātuk_VII.11 Upekhā-sahagatehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā te dhammā katīhi khandhehi katīhi āyatanehi katīhi dhātūhi vippayuttā?
dt2.7:11.2: Te dhammā na kehici khandhehi na kehici āyatanehi pañcahi dhātūhi vippayuttā.
dt2.7:12.2: Dhātusu satta dve pi ca indriyāno.
